swahost-dbg.description: Diagnostic only: final-hc on its log-only debug tree. c6f392a28b = PC3's PFXDBG admission log (53614116f3, on a0491db764) + full_kv (Full-layer prefix present on device or host before the SWA validator), session-instance hash, host/device free slots per pool, and counters of failed write-through backups and unbacked device evictions. Nothing reads the logged values. Run in a 28G scope.

swahost-r020.description: Pool-split lever L1: swahost-dbg with --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.2 (final-hc: 0.268). The device bytes are unchanged; device pools go from 160,395 full + 42,985 SWA to ~197K + ~39K tokens. --hicache-size 12 is split by device bytes, so the host pools go from 318K full (3.26 GB) + 85K SWA (8.74 GB) to ~392K + ~79K. Pool sizes only: per-token compute is unchanged.
